mechanism: Propylthiouracil may increase gentamicin nephrotoxicity and ototoxicity risk through altered renal perfusion in hyperthyroid patients; both drugs can cause agranulocytosis independently with additive bone marrow suppression potential.
action: Monitor renal function, urinalysis, and audiometry during concurrent use; ensure adequate hydration and dose gentamicin appropriately for renal function; consider therapeutic drug monitoring of gentamicin levels.
